notes.title: Patch 1.29 Preview
notes.content:
We are glad to announce that the new Possessed role is finally here! Ravenman, the new Possessed, has the ability to shift into a raven and fly far quicker than other players.  Have a safe flight! 

Meanwhile, we have created a new shop item called Spiritual Bone that can launch an emergency mission and is only available to the Possessed in order to help them to win over the survivors.

Following are the specifics: 

[h3]New features[/h3]

● Roles of each possessed will be randomly picked from Teleporter, Shapeshifter, and Ravenman, without replacement. 

【New Possessed role: Ravenman】
● Ravenman can shift freely into a raven at any time, but can not transport after the Crismon Dream.
● While being a raven, Ravenman can not activate the Crismon Dream but can shift during one. 
● While being a ravenman, Ravenman can not be hit by a Wooden Bat. 

【Emergency Mission - Possessed Item: Spiritual Bone】
● After purchasing the Spiritual Bone from the shop, the Possessed can use it to start the Emergency Mission. the Altar will be shut down temporarily, and the countdown of the rituals will also pause at the same time. 
● On the map, two emergency mission points will appear at random. The Altar will reopen and the players can resume their rituals after they have completed tasks of both Emergency mission points. 
● During the emergency mission, meetings can be called.
● The Spiritual Bone in the shop will have a 240-second cooldown after being purchased. The cooldown will suspend once the Emergency Mission starts and will resume when Emergency Mission ends. 
● Each Possessed can hold one Spiritual Bone at most. Spiritual Bone can be used without cooldown restriction. Spiritual Bone can not be used repeatedly during Emergency Mission.
● The Possessed can start the Crimson Dream during the Emergency mission but can not use  Spiritual Bone during the Crimson Dream.


[h3]Art optimization[/h3]

● Added a melting visual effect for the Altar when a ritual is finished.

notes.title: Patch 1.26 Preview
notes.content:
As the speed of completing the Ritual varies greatly among players of different levels, we added an offering amount option in room settings so that players can adjust the number of offerings according to their needs and game pace. 

Besides, we noticed that the behavior of the Possessed still cannot meet our expectations. Thus, this update includes some balance adjustments for Possessed together with some function optimizations. 

Details are as followed. 

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
● The prices of Wooden Bat, Corrupted Crystal Core, Bird and Amulet of Telepathy decrease to 10.  
● The evil energy gain of using one Corrupted Crystal Core increases to 25.
【Possessed energy recharge adjustment】
● The evil energy retained from not killing anyone during Crimson Dream increases from 75 to 85.
● Possessed now can gain more evil energy per second. 
● Transformed Possessed can no longer gain evil energy during Crimson Dream. 

[h3]Function optimization:[/h3]
● Curse Skull now becomes recharged ability. Curse energy will be fully recharged every 90 seconds(maximum accumulate 3 times). Curse Skull is removed from the shop. 
This adjustment aims for helping the Possessed play against the Survivors more easily. 
● Room settings: added offering amount selection. 
【Adjustments for Amulet of Telepathy】
● The player who owns Amulet of Telepathy cannot be traced. 
● Amulet of Telepathy can prevent the owner from being cursed once. It will be broken after this prevention. 
● Notification will pop up when Amulet of Telepathy is broken.
● Shapeshifter can shift during Crimson Dream. 
● The action of placing the Lantern and the Bird has been sped up.

[h3]Arts:[/h3]
● Added a cloud of smoke at the place where the Possessed disappeared after teleportation. 
● Added a cyclic screen image effect during the period of Shapeshifter shift to other players.  

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
● Fixed a bug that the invisible player becomes visible when Crimson Dream starts. 
● Fixed a bug that players can be seen through chests. 
● Fixed a bug that the player can trigger the effect of Corrupted Crystal Core several times.

Thank you all for your suggestions and support. If you have any ideas, tell us under the Discord channel #game-feedback

notes.title: Patch 1.24 Preview
notes.content:
To make the gameplay more diverse and playful, we design a new occupation, “Shapeshifter”, for the Possessed.

Besides, based on the recent feedback from our players, we have noticed that it is a bit hard to gather 8 players to start a game. Thus, we decided to come up with a beginner mode. In this mode, only 5 players are needed to start a game. 

More details are as follows. 

[h2]New features:[/h2]
● New Possessed occupation: Shapeshifter. 
Shapeshifter can shift to any player in the game (including Shapeshifter) at any time. After updating this version, each game will have two Possessed with Teleport and Shift abilities respectively. The Possessed with Shift ability will not be able to teleport after Crismon Dream. 

● New Beginner mode: Only 5 players are needed to start the game.
1. Survivors need to complete 4 rounds of Ritual. The number of offerings needed by each round is reduced respectively. 
2. The result of the first discussion is execution instead of tie-up. 
3. There are four Survivors and one Possessed(with teleport ability).
4. Certain items are not allowed to be sold in this mode. 

[h2]Balance: [/h2]
● The amount of Faith gained from Consecration and Desecration decreases from 16 to 12.
● The amount of Faith gained from completing the Ritual decreases from 8 to 0.
● The price of backpack increases from 15 to 20. 
● The price of EMF increases from 10 to 15. 
● The price of Corrupted Crystal Core decreases from 20 to 15.

[h2]Function optimization:[/h2]
● Players can hold nothing in their hand by scrolling the mouse pulley
● Possessed are allowed to use items at the interval between the end of Crismon Dream and the start of Dawn. 

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
● Fixed a bug that the Possessed suddenly put their hands down during the process of transforming 
● Fixed a bug that the duration of scene switching from voting result to execution animation is too long
● Fixed a bug that players cannot mark their location during the discussion
● Fixed a display bug that microphone icons of all players start flashing when someone clicks the ready button

[h3]The details are as follows:[/h3]
● The breach will be adjusted as two separate ones in different locations.
● Adjusted the visual effect of Night vision camera. Speed will be slightly reduced while using this equipment.
● Added a landing movement for players who jumped from the second floor to the first floor.
● Added a blinking light on the Night vision camera. This will allow the Possessed to find targets easily.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
● Added new equipment Corrupted Crystal Core: use on a distant target to reduce their sanity by 20 points and gain 20 points of evil energy.
● Added mic test in settings. Players now can adjust their mic volume themselves.

● Players can press Z to skip voting with their map showing during a meeting.

[h3]Art[/h3]
● Added the animation for landing movement.
● Added new animation for new equipment.
● Optimized the visual effect of Night vision camera.
● Optimized vision for dead players.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

● Fixed a bug that players that got tied up will receive the wrong notification while getting killed by the Possessed
● Fixed a bug that players that got tied up will look untied after getting attacked by the Wraiths.

notes.title: Patch1.21 Preview
notes.content:
Hello, players! We hope you’ve been enjoying the first few weeks of Sinister Night! This build will bring a variety of changes, fixes, new features, balance, etc. 

Based on the current gaming environment, in order to win, the Possessed need to pick their next victim and the timing carefully. However, because of the unstable effect of using the Cursed Skull while Survivors can manage to stay alive in multiply ways, it‘s hard for Possessed to kill a specific target yet still be able to fake an alibi or frame others. Therefore, this update will help with the mentioned issues. 
[h3]The details are as follows:[/h3]
● [b]Untransformed possessed can see other players in Crimson Dream.[/b]
● [b]When Crimson Dream is fading away, Possessed will gain extra Clairvoyance automatically. [/b]
● Clairvoyance: cooldown reduced from 10 to 8 seconds and duration reduced from 5 to 4 seconds.
● Crimson Dream: Cooldown reduced from 95 to 80 seconds, 40 seconds if no Survivors were killed.
● Voice channel of possessed  will be automatically activated during Crimson Dream.
● The number of offerings sightly reduced.
● Altar quests duration changed from 360 seconds to: 360 / 300 / 270 / 270 / 240 / 210s.
● Increased the energy gained by possessed when the altar quests time out to: 30 / 30 / 40 / 40 / 50 / 50.
● Reduced duration of overtime for altar quests to 120 / 120 / 100 / 100 / 80 / 80.

[h3]New Feature[/h3]
● [b]Added new equipment Lantern: players can place the Lantern on the floor, it provides additional lighting and Sanity regain.[/b]
● Players who got tied up can now be freed by others.
● Players can press U to respawn if they are stuck at certain places.

[h3]Balance[/h3]
● Players can purchase no more than two sets of bird cages.
● Visible range for triggered bird cages has decreased.
● Possessed can gain 100% evil energy if they use Dagger of Sacrifice to kill another Possessed.
● The possessed's first-person kill animation is accelerated now.
● The possessed can still regenerate energy when they are being tied up.
● During Crimson Dreams, Survivors in the conference room can no longer gain Sanity.
● Regain Sanity after Crimson Dream reduced from 20 to 15.
● Players can not run while wearing Night-vision Camera.
● Players are now able to talk once they got killed instead of after the Crimson Dream ends.

[h3]Functions [/h3]
● Interaction detection optimized.
● Added notified messages for players when other players went disconnected.
● Players can vote by clicking the player list on the left during a meeting.
● Optimized the item corner label.
● Added a Video to the tutorial.
● Optimized the display status of disconnected players.

[h3]Arts: [/h3]
● Map UI optimized.
● New outfit design and model optimized for some characters.
● Animation of players’ movements optimized.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
● Fixed a bug that the sound effect of players using Sedative can be heard by all players. 
● Fixed a bug that Possessed can activate Crimson Dream after 6 rituals are complete.
● Fixed a bug that players can not see the animation of other players getting killed.
● Fixed a display bug with the password input prompts of a room that does not vanish.
● Fixed a bug which players can not see any notification.
● Fixed a bug that players’ mic icons are still activated after muted.
● Fixed a bug that players remain being tied up after getting untied.
● Fixed a bug that sound effect with low sanity is still activated after players got killed.
● Fixed a bug in which players were unable to join a meeting right after players got killed.
● Fixed a bug that Possessed’ s voice chat can be heard by all players once the Crimson Dream ended.
● Fixed a bug that the color of the mark on Map doesn't match with players that did not mark during a meeting.
● Fixed a display bug that shows the report option during meeting.
● Fixed a bug that if players using Assembly Bell and Possessed transforming at the same time, the Possessed can not join the meeting.
● Fixed a bug that players can see all player’s numbers in Crimson Dream after they got killed.
● Fixed a bug that all players had incorrect movement when Crimson Dream started.

notes.title: Patch 1.20 Notes
notes.content:
Hi guys! Sinister Night has been released for a week. During this week, we have received many suggestions and feedback from the community. which will motivate our team to better optimize the game. 
This patch update will cover many issues that everyone cares about recently, including new features, balance, game optimization, etc. The details are as follows:

[h2]New Features [/h2]
[list]
[*] Add new equipment Dagger of Sacrifice: Gives the possessed the ability to kill his teammates, and at the same time inherit the energy of his teammates.
[*] Victims will now hold their last breath until the end of the next meeting and can participate in discussions and votes.
[*] We hope that the possessed can more strategically choose the timing of the Crimson Dream, rather than randomly transforming in front of the victim.
[*] Added mouse sensitivity adjustment in the settings menu.
[*] Added status display for offline players. 
[*] Added status display on who is speaking during the game exploration phase.
[*] Added a list of players who haven't mark their location during the meeting.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
Because the percentage of winning by completing the ritual is too high, We made two optimizations:
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the number of ritual offering items on the map.
[*] Possessed: Increased Evil Energy gained by desecrating the altar from 40 to 50. 
[/list]
Survivors have too many gold coins, which makes purchasing items less strategic. Therefore, the automatic growth of gold coins is weakened.
[list]
[*] Survivor: The time to obtain 1 gold has been increased from 30 seconds to 40 seconds.
[/list]
Since there are many ways for survivors to save their lives in the Crimson Dream, we have slightly reduced the difficulty for the possessed to find their targets.
[list]
[*] Possessed: Possessed now have better vision during Crimson Dream. 
[/list]
The duration of the Invisibility Tonic is so short that it has no value to the possessed. We differentiated the duration of invisibility in different stages, hope this item is now useful for the possessed.
[list]
[*] Invisibility Tonic: During the exploration phase, its duration is increased to 6 seconds. In Crimson Dreams, the duration is reduced to 3 seconds.
[/list]
Bird cages can precisely locate the possessed, and at the same time are too cheap.
[list]
[*] Bird Cage: Cost increased from 10 to 15 coins.
[/list]

[h2]Arts [/h2]
[list]

notes.title: Update Preview
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Sinister Night, as the first indie game developed by a small studio team, is very honored to have received so much support. We’re very grateful to all the players who have experienced our game.

In addition, we have received feedback from many enthusiastic players, which  we take very seriously. We would like to take this opportunity to share the upcoming update plans with you:

[h2]Clean Verison[/h2]

We’ve received some feedback that the excessive horror elements may be too scary for players. In addition, animation with gore and violence is not suitable for live streaming.

We're going to add a clean version with less gore and horror elements. Players can switch between the standard version and the clean version in the settings, so that different players can enjoy the game.

[h2]Experience Optimization[/h2]

In the feedback, issues such as voice chat and scene lighting are frequently mentioned. In addition, some players are dropped but the rest of the players are not aware of it that will also affect the normal experience of players.

We’re going to upload optimized versions for above issues:

[list]
[*] Add scene lighting to enhance players’ vision in the Crimson Dream.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Add disconnected state display for the convenience of other players if a player is not in the game.
[/list]

[h2]Newbie Starter Program[/h2]

Although we have a tutorial system and in-game novice guidelines, there are still many players who expressed confusion about our gameplay in their feedback. Especially in the equipmnet system, new players may be confused of the items usages, which affects the direction of the game.

We’re going to release new contents inside and outside the game to help players get started with the game:

[list]
[*]  Release an instructional short video to briefly introduce the goals and basic gameplay.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Optimize some art resources to make these guiding signs more understandable.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Optimize the description text of store items, and also add detailed descriptions of equipment in the tutorial to help you understand the specific role of each item.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Add more items for players to pick up in the conference room at the beginning of the game and add more random pick-up equipment in the map, which is convenient for players to get started and experience the game better.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Adjustment[/h2]

Through observation and testing we have noticed that the balance needs to be further adjusted so that both the survivor and the possessed can have a better game experience. We’re going to solve the problems at priority that it is difficult for survivors to purchase items and the effect of some items is weak.

[list]
[*]  Mechanism modification: Survivors is able to gain Faith more easily in the game.
[/list]
[list]
[*]  Item adjustment: items such as bat, tranquilizer, etc. is adjusted numerically or mechanically.
[/list]

These are our plans on optimizing various aspects of the game. We are working hard to realize it gradually. Feel free to contact us if you have any ideas, and we are more than happy to receive your feedback. We hope you can give us a little patience and support to help us become better. 

Thank you all sincerely.

notes.title: Development Log # 4
notes.content:
Hello everyone, great to see you again. We have shared some of the game scenes and character designs from SINISTER NIGHT in our previous updates. Since then, we have received lots of responses and feedback. We would like to thank you all for your support towards our team and every comment is greatly appreciated. 

Today, we would like to share the unique gameplay of SINISTER NIGHT and some behind-the-scene stories of this thrilling game. 

[h3]Gameplay Settings[/h3]

SINISTER NIGHT is based on a series of mysterious incidents in an old Gnostic school. Players play the role of streamers. There are eight streamers  and they enter this abandoned school to shoot a horror reality show. Two of them are possessed by the nun Dorothy and they lie to deceive and split the team in order to kill them all. The other six streamers, as survivors, need to complete rituals within a limited time to get out alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42349844/0ec80b98d12fc7209ba207372c1267c48090f166.gif[/img]

[h3]Immersive Horror Experience[/h3]

We’re aimed at designing a game that gives players an immersive horror experience. In order to create an atmosphere full of tension and suspense, we use sophisticated modeling, horror elements and fragmented narrative. What’s more, our gameplay fuses social deduction with psychological horror to further the experience of paranoia and mistrust.

[i]To be honest, I was killed for many times by my so-called teammates during alpha test. Trust me, it is very horrifying.[/i]

In the game, players witness lots of supernatural incidents such as the door is suddenly closed, the phone is ringing oddly. After a series of mental torture, players realize that they need to escape from here as soon as possible. Players need complete 6 rounds of rituals, however, the possessed is also mixed in the team to destroy the ritual. Therefore, for survivors, it is necessary to pay attention to the movements and speeches made by each player, complete the rituals as soon as possible or find out the possessed among you; for the possessed, it is important to hide and wait for opportunities to kill. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42349844/7d78b63ba6e2d792d278b540cdeabd41f2c5bf75.gif[/img]

[h3]More Fun Than Mafia[/h3]

Our team members are obsessed with Mafia, so we hope to keep the fun of social deduction. If you are familiar with Mafia, you are ready for SINISTER NIGHT. We also have perfect equipment and inventory system designed to enrich the game experience. For example, EMF is used to detect wraiths to survive, and Satan’s Blood is used to start massacre.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42349844/c840a29b5ac813965d4f585eb2735f2b0fe499ed.png[/img]

[h3]Behind The Scene[/h3]

During alpha test, the haunting wraiths still manage to spook everyone even if we considered ourselves are very experienced in the game. Some of them even fall off their chairs! Not just for that, some creative coworkers always like to come up with crazy ideas and hit their teammates with a wooden bat! Feel free to explore more fun ideas when the game is launched!

[b]Stay tuned! SINISTER NIGHT will be released soon![/b]
